title: Computer-based cognitive screening of brain tumor patients
summary: Patients with planned brain tumor surgery are examined preoperatively for cognitive changes/deficits using a computer-based (RehaCom® Software). 2-3 days after the operation, and at a follow-up appointment after 3-6 weeks, a new assessment of cognitive functions is carried out postoperatively. At the end of the screening, the level of exertion is recorded using the Borg scale, and the duration of the test is also documented.

interventions.name: In brain tumour patients (meningioma), cognitive performance is assessed before and after the operation using computer-based screening (RehaCom® software).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- German as first language
- Arabic as first language
- Signed written consent form
- Diagnosis with Meningeoma 
- Clinical indication for an operation
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy and Breastfeeding
- No sufficient knowledge oft he above mentiond languages
